title: WSS guide: wrong JMAP data type named — PresenceStatus should be ChatContact (two places)
description: Two sections name the wrong data type when describing what changes when another contact's presence updates. The two-event-tracks section says a confused implementer would call PresenceStatus/changes; the presence section says pushState catch-up delivers PresenceStatus state-change events for contacts. PresenceStatus is the owner's own record. Other contacts' presence is a field on ChatContact, so the relevant state-change type is ChatContact and the wrong call a confused implementer would make is ChatContact/changes. Both instances need correction.
